comment: Reference game UIs for markup recreation qualification. Remote images are fetched at test time over pinned TLS into a bounded per-run in-memory cache, authenticated against the committed SHA-256/byte/media-type identity, and never redistributed; no remote bytes are written to disk. Thresholds are measured multi-signal baselines: each recreation must clear the geometry, color, and detail thresholds independently or the qualification fails, and the coarse layout baseline is retained as a diagnostic only.
